scope: Short differential diagnostic, not preparation acceptance. Identical initial checkpoint state/history per branch. Original servo cap50/s, cap5/s, and fixed-cell hold; drag/timestep/force law/geometry/overlap limit unchanged. Near-limit provides failure reproduction; earlier tests relaxation without immediate threshold proximity. Time windows 5us/10us do not establish asymptotic equilibrium or safe long-term preparation.
interpretation: Report completion/rejection, overlap trends, pressure, kinetic/elastic ratio, worst contact identity, and cell change. A hold rejection does not by itself isolate geometry from inherited velocity or contact-force effects. Fixed-cell endpoints must match initial cell exactly. No relaxed limits, admission or production default changes.
